newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says state will still guarantee pension.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says state will still guarantee pension.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major, announcing proposed reforms to the state pension system, said the state would continue to guarantee a basic minimum pension.

He told a news conference his aim was to ensure that the younger generation could look forward to a pension fund built up in their own name. "To remove fears and misunderstandings, let me make this point clear -- the state will continue to guarantee that everyone will receive at least their basic state pension as now, uprated to take account of inflation," he said.
Major said the heart of the proposals, to be outlined by Social Security Secretary Peter Lilley, would be a scheme known as "Basic Pension Plus."
